newsitem.title: UK: Scot Metropolitan buys Edinburgh dept store.
newsitem.headline: Scot Metropolitan buys Edinburgh dept store.

text.p: The Scottish Metropolitan Property Plc said on Wednesday it had bought a feuhold interest in a John Lewis department store forming a key part of a large shopping centre in Edinburgh's Princes Street for 4.25 million stg.
A feuhold is a Scottish form of property freeholding.
The company said in a statement that after buying the property from Edinburgh City Council it expected it would show a yield of around 6.5 percent.
The store covers about 220,000 square feet in the St James shopping centre. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
